name: restful-booker-api-tests
description: Postman and Newman tests for the public Restful-Booker API.

scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:data
scripts.test:api: mkdir -p reports && newman run postman/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e postman/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder Health --folder Auth --folder Booking --folder Negative --timeout-request 30000 --timeout-script 30000 --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/newman-report.html --reporter-json-export reports/newman-report.json --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful-Booker API tests" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "Restful-Booker API tests"
scripts.test:data: mkdir -p reports && newman run postman/restful-booker.postman_collection.json -e postman/restful-booker.postman_environment.json --folder DataDriven -d data/bookings.csv --timeout-request 30000 --timeout-script 30000 --reporters cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/data-driven-report.html --reporter-json-export reports/data-driven-report.json --reporter-htmlextra-title "Restful-Booker data-driven tests" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "Restful-Booker data-driven tests"
